subject: Merchant onboarding: payment methods, remit instructions, and PO expectations
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@sagepay.example.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.example.com>
Cc: vendor_ops@sagepay.example.com
Date: 2026-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SagePay vendor onboarding — banking details and remit contact

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're ready to kick off the onboarding for SagePay so we can receive PO'd work and start billing monthly. To get things moving on our side, could you confirm the following:

- Which payment method does Redwood prefer for US vendors (ACH vs wire)?
- Preferred invoice submission method: email remit address, portal upload, or both?
- Remittance email address where you send payment confirmations/advices (example: ap@redwood.example.com)
- Standard payment terms (Net30/Net45/Net60) and whether PO numbers are required on invoices

Attached is our W‑9 and the bank letter (PDF). We'll fill out any vendor form you send over.

Attaching: SagePay_W9.pdf, SagePay_bank_letter.pdf

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Finance Operations — SagePay, Inc.
M: +1 415 555 0143
vendor_ops@sagepay.example.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.example.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@sagepay.example.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SagePay vendor onboarding — banking details and remit contact

Hi Marta — great to meet you. Welcome — we'll get SagePay set up in Redwood's vendor system. Quick answers and a short checklist below.

Short answers:
- Preferred method (US): ACH is our preference for cost and speed; wires are acceptable for international/non-US accounts.
- Invoice submission: ap@redwood-payments.example.com is our primary remit inbox. We also accept invoices via our vendor portal if you'd like an automated upload confirmation.
- Remittance advices: we send email advices to the remit address that appears on the vendor record (ap@redwood-payments.example.com).
- Payment terms: standard is Net30 for first commercial customers; Net45/Net60 can be reviewed for negotiated contracts.
- PO requirement: PO numbers are required for any invoice over $5,000 and for recurring monthly billings tied to a contract. Please include the PO on the invoice.

Required docs to complete intake (please send back as attachments or upload to the portal):
1) Completed Redwood Vendor Onboarding Form (attached template)
2) W‑9 (already attached from you — thanks)
3) Bank letter or voided check (for ACH setup)
4) Legal remit/contact name and remit email (we'll use ap@redwood-payments.example.com to send advices unless you specify otherwise)
5) Signed vendor agreement (we can send DocuSign — see link below)

Next steps:
- I'll route items to Finance (Laura) for verification once you return the completed form and bank letter.
- Ben, looping you to confirm PO cadence with the sales contract.

DocuSign: https://redwood.app/docusign/RDW-4821
Attached: vendor_onboarding_template.xlsx

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@sagepay.example.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.example.com>
Cc: vendor_ops@sagepay.example.com
Date: 2026-10-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SagePay vendor onboarding — banking details and remit contact

Thanks Vivek — attaching the bank letter and completed W‑9 (already have). A few clarifying items from our side: 

- We can accept ACH for US payments. Bank prefers to receive payment as ACH when possible.
- For international invoices, wiring instructions included in the bank letter (attached).
- Regarding invoice submission: we'd prefer to email invoices to ap@redwood-payments.example.com and receive a remittance confirmation to vendor_ops@sagepay.example.com. Is that feasible?
- Payment terms: our standard is Net30 but we can accept Net45 if Redwood requires. Do you require a PO to be issued before the first invoice, or can we bill against an initial contract reference and the PO follow?

Attached: SagePay_bank_letter.pdf

> Hi Marta — great to meet you. Welcome — we'll get SagePay set up in Redwood's vendor system. Quick answers and a short checklist below.
> 
> Short answers:
> - Preferred method (US): ACH is our preference for cost and speed; wires are acceptable for international/non-US accounts.
> - Invoice submission: ap@redwood-payments.example.com is our primary remit inbox. We also accept invoices via our vendor portal if you'd like an automated upload confirmation.
> - Remittance advices: we send email advices to the remit address that appears on the vendor record (ap@redwood-payments.example.com).

Thanks,
Marta

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.example.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.example.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SagePay vendor onboarding — internal next steps

Internal — quick ops note:

- Approve Net30 for initial setup. Finance will accept Net45/Net60 only if commercial approves and procurement flags it in the vendor record.
- Once we receive the completed onboarding template and bank letter, AP will perform a bank verification and Tax ID match.
- We will not set active payment routing until a vendor record is fully validated and a PO number is created for the first invoice >$5k. For first invoice billing against an initial contract reference, we can set a provisional vendor code but require PO within 30 days.

Link to intake checklist (internal): drive:/Finance/Vendor-Intake/standard-checklist.pdf

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.example.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@sagepay.example.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.example.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SagePay vendor onboarding — banking details and remit contact

Hi Marta — thanks for the bank letter. Confirming the following so we have a single source of truth: 

- Payment method preference: Redwood prefers ACH for US accounts; wire only for international.
- Remit inbox: please send invoices to ap@redwood-payments.example.com. We'll send remittance advices back to vendor_ops@sagepay.example.com once payments are issued.
- Payment terms: Net30 (confirmed). We can discuss Net45/Nets case-by-case but finance has approved Net30 to start.
- PO process: PO required for invoices >$5,000. For the first invoice, you may bill to the contract reference and include the PO on the invoice once issued; AP will set a provisional code for the first payment pending PO issuance within 30 days.
- Please include the PO number on the invoice and the contract reference in the invoice body to avoid delays.

Next steps for your team:
1) Upload the completed vendor_onboarding_template.xlsx with the bank letter (you already attached) to the vendor portal OR reply to this thread with the completed file.
2) Sign the vendor agreement (DocuSign link below) so we can finalize contract terms.
3) Once AP verifies bank + Tax ID, we'll confirm vendor activation and expected payment date (usually next AP cycle within 7–14 business days after activation).

DocuSign: https://redwood.app/docusign/RDW-4821
AP remit email: ap@redwood-payments.example.com

If you confirm you'll send invoices to ap@redwood-payments.example.com and add the PO number as discussed, we can proceed.

Best regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
